## Trends (as of 2026-10-14)
- Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2: Nintendo's first special-edition Switch 2. Triforce dock, green and gold Joy-Con, $519.99. Pre-orders vanished in minutes. Source: https://www.nintendo.co.jp/corporate/release/en/2026/260908_2.html
- Ocarina of Time remake: The N64 legend, rebuilt for Switch 2. Real jump button, free camera, and yes, you can hum into the mic. Source: https://www.gematsu.com/2026/09/the-legend-of-zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-launches-november-5
- GTA VI: Five weeks out. Preload opens Nov 12. The internet is already counting the minutes. Source: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/
- VisionQuest on Disney+: Paul Bettany is back as Vision and James Spader's Ultron is in his head. Episodes 1 and 2 dropped Oct 13. It's trending on X. Source: https://www.disneyplus.com/explore/articles/marvel-visionquest
- DWTS Super Bowl Night: Joe Buck guest-judged and admitted he knows nothing about dancing. Fan favorite Guillermo got sent home. Source: https://www.tvinsider.com/1297039/dancing-with-the-stars-super-bowl-night-2026-scores-eliminated-recap/
- Helluva Boss S3: Prime Video is dropping it weekly and the fandom is loud. The Part 1 finale lands Oct 28. Source: https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/fantasy/helluva-boss-season-3-release-schedule/
- Narnia: The Magician's Nephew trailer: Greta Gerwig's Narnia, scored to Stairway to Heaven, with Meryl Streep voicing Aslan. Big swing. Our take: it works. Source: https://variety.com/2026/film/news/narnia-the-magicians-nephew-trailer-greta-gerwig-netflix-1236909994/
- Other Mommy wins the box office: Jessica Chastain horror, D-plus CinemaScore, $27.5M opening anyway. Critics hated it. Audiences showed up. Source: https://deadline.com/2026/10/box-office-other-mommy-social-reckoning-1237151001/
- The Social Reckoning flops: Aaron Sorkin's Facebook follow-up opened to just $5.5M. Ouch. Source: https://deadline.com/2026/10/box-office-other-mommy-social-reckoning-1237151001/
- Street Fighter hits theaters: Paramount's PG-13 Street Fighter movie opens this Friday, IMAX included. Source: https://www.paramountpictures.com/movies/street-fighter
- Danny Trejo vs. the internet: Trejo says he's "not pro-ICE" after backlash over a Daily Wire movie. His son says he'd never heard of Ben Shapiro. Source: https://www.usatoday.com/story/entertainment/movies/2026/10/13/danny-trejo-ice-movie-ben-shapiro/92228770007/
- Taylor Swift's "Patient Zero": Second straight week at No. 1 on the Hot 100. Her 16th chart-topper. TikTok is using it for wedding edits. Source: https://www.billboard.com/lists/taylor-swift-patient-zero-hot-100-number-one-second-week/
- Drake & Don Toliver debut at No. 5: New collab, straight into the Hot 100 top 5. Also on that chart: ADÉLA's first top 10. Source: https://www.billboard.com/lists/taylor-swift-patient-zero-hot-100-number-one-second-week/
- "we fell in love in october": girl in red's song is the fastest-climbing TikTok sound right now, with 2M+ videos and still going. Peak fall. Source: https://kabo.sh/tools/trending-tiktok-sounds
- KAROL G "BbY WOW": Up 26% in TikTok videos in a single day. Small but climbing fast, so catch it early. Source: https://kabo.sh/tools/trending-tiktok-sounds
- Grammy nominations: The 2027 nominees drop Monday, Nov 16. The ceremony is Feb 7 on ABC, Disney+ and Hulu. Source: https://www.grammy.com/news/2027-grammys-show-air-date-nominations-announced/
- NBA opening night: Knicks raise the banner, LeBron debuts for Philly, and NBC has the first-ever opening tripleheader. Source: https://www.nba.com/news/2026-27-nba-regular-season-schedule
- NHL: where to watch: 84-game season, split between ESPN and TNT. Heritage Classic Oct 25. Source: https://www.nhl.com/news/2026-2027-national-tv-schedule-announced
- Bills 37, Rams 34 (OT): A blocked field goal, then a walk-off kick. Josh Allen's first career OT win. Super Bowl preview? Maybe. Source: https://apnews.com/article/rams-bills-score-4fdc64fbeb421f66a516bb0b4d566863
- MLB LCS: Rays-Guardians, Brewers-Dodgers: The final four. World Series starts Oct 23. Source: https://www.mlb.com/news/mlb-2026-league-championship-series-matchups
- Google Gemini 4 Argon: Google's new frontier model, out Oct 13 with a 1M-token window. It's pitched as less hedgy and less cliché. Source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-argon/
- Meta Muse Wonder: Meta's first frontier model. Not open-weight this time, which is a big shift from Llama. Source: https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-meta-muse-wonder-ai-models-launch/
- Microsoft Maia 300 chip: Microsoft's third in-house AI chip. The pitch: 40% better performance per megawatt. Deployment is planned for 2027. Source: https://ai.tldr.tech/p/2026-10-13-tldr-ai
- Starshield speed cap in Ukraine: Ukraine says SpaceX capped moving Starshield terminals at 100 mph with no warning. Starshield is trending on X. Source: https://kyivindependent.com/this-cannot-be-a-coincidence-ukraines-starlink-access-restricted-without-warning-zelensky-adviser-says/
- iPhone Duo pre-orders: Apple's first foldable. $1,999. Pre-orders open Oct 16 at 5 a.m. PT and it ships Oct 23. Source: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/09/apple-unveils-iphone-duo/
- Copper & cherry-cola hair: Pinterest's first Beauty Trend Report says hair is going warm and moody: mocha, copper, cherry cola. Source: https://newsroom.pinterest.com/news/beauty-trend-report-2026/
- Ghost Rose nails: Milky, blush-nude nails beating burgundy this fall. Quiet but very chic. Source: https://www.elle.com/beauty/a73916869/ghost-rose-nails-trend/
- Smoky eyes + burgundy lips: Clean girl is taking a night off. Runways from Saint Laurent to Gucci brought the smoke back. Source: https://pagesix.com/2026/10/06/style/fall-makeup-trends-2026/
- Taco Bell x Milk Bar Birthday Cake Empanada: Cake-flavored empanada with pink frosting and sprinkles. $3.49. Chaotic in the best way. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/taco-bell-and-milk-bar-reunite-for-all-new-birthday-cake-empanada-302901760.html
- Wingstop x Sour Patch Kids wings: Wings in a sour-then-sweet glaze. We're scared. We're also going. Source: https://www.qsrmagazine.com/news/wingstop-announces-wings-flavored-with-sour-patch-kids-glaze/
- Dunkin' Spider Donut is back: The Halloween Spider Donut returns, plus a purple Berry Battie drink. Source: https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/food/2026/10/14/dunkin-spider-donut-berry-battie-halloween/92232735007/
- Popeyes x Megan Thee Stallion: A new Honey Chicken Biscuit with a Megan Thee Stallion merch tie-in. Source: https://news.popeyes.com/blog-posts/want-to-try-the-new-popeyes-honey-chicken-biscuit-and-score-a-megan-thee-stallion-t-shirt-heres-how
- The "Six Seven" dance: A Brazilian funk track: count on your fingers, shrug on the drop. J-Hope did it and the top video hit 75M+ views. Source: https://lightreel.ai/blogs/whats-trending-on-tiktok
- Ramalama costume walk: A creepy low-angle shot zooms out to reveal the Halloween fit, set to Róisín Murphy. Easy to copy, hard to stop watching. Source: https://newengen.com/insights/october-tiktok-trends/
- Pumpkin Head Illusion: Hold a pumpkin up to the lens and congratulations, you're a pumpkin. Spooky-season gold. Source: https://newengen.com/insights/october-tiktok-trends/
- AI cat melodrama: Synthetic cats acting out family dramas and tiny tragedies. Weirdly emotional, and a fast-breaking format. Source: https://lightreel.ai/blogs/whats-trending-on-tiktok
- Bank of America beats: Q3 came in strong even with a $1.2B Treasury penalty. Bank of America is trending on X. Source: https://investor.bankofamerica.com/events-and-presentations/events/detail/20261014-q3-2026-bank-of-america-earnings-conference-call?wcmmode=disabled
- J&J slides after earnings: It beat estimates, then fell 5.73%. The culprits: a talc-related charge and soft MedTech sales. Source: https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/why-is-johnson--johnson-stock-tumbling-7-today-93CH-4947310
- Chip stocks wobble: AMAT, Micron and KLA fell after Broadcom's CEO said some AI investment looks like "casino gambling". Source: https://swingfolio.com/daily/us/2026-10-13/afternoon
- Open enrollment 2027: HealthCare.gov opens Nov 1. Enroll by Dec 15 for Jan 1 coverage. It closes Jan 15. Source: https://www.healthcare.gov/quick-guide/dates-and-deadlines/
- SpaceX CRS-35 heads to the ISS: 6,300+ lbs of cargo, including the station's final roll-out solar arrays. Dragon docks Oct 15. Source: https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-science-cargo-launch-on-35th-spacex-resupply-mission-to-station/
- Artemis III booster stacked: NASA finished stacking the boosters for the Moon-landing mission, with all four RS-25 engines installed. Source: https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/missions/2026/10/13/nasa-completes-artemis-iii-booster-stacking-shares-status-update/
- Holiday airfares spike: Hopper says Thanksgiving domestic fares average $402, up 31%. Book by late October. Seriously. Source: https://www.travelagewest.com/Industry-Insight/Opinion/holiday-travel-fares-10-year-high
